notes.title: Patch v0.103
notes.notes:
[b]*Please note*[/b] Major content patches are subject to bugs. There is a chance that a new feature will not work correctly. Please report any issues and we will have them fixed ASAP! We thank you for your patience and understanding. QA while solo developing is challenging!

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Cufflink Combos. Try comboing an uppercut into a spike or a kick.
[*] Updated how the spike (“Meteor Cufflink”) calculates whether or not it hits an enemy. It should feel much more natural using it now.
[*] 2 new achievements! 
[*] Updated system how attacks calculate whether they hit or not depending on their height compared to the target’s height.
[*] Money now has an infinite pickup range.
[*] Telephones now remove any burning or needle based debuffs.
[*] There was a group of traffic cones on the main diagonal street that dropped two items. That was an oversight and one of the items has been moved to a different nearby group of traffic cones.
[*] A certain potion vendor now instantly wakes up when a certain creature is close. In addition, refusing the offer is now pointless.
[*] New NPC appears in a secret area when a certain condition is met.
[*] After defeating the final boss, there is now a new note that can be read back at the station.
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] SPLOZO explosions do a lot more stun damage now.
[*] Made the hitbox that thrown items use to detect a hit bigger.
[*] In the final boss’ final phase, he now will jump up to the rafters every 30 seconds guaranteed (giving you more chances to breathe).
[*] Parrying certain high power attacks no longer stuns enemies but instead applies 0.5 sec of hitstun. 
[/list]
[b]Sounds[/b]
[list]
[*] When you’re about to get stunned a heartbeat sound now plays.
[*] Randomized the pitches of many different sounds which tend to play multiple times at once (eg 5 traffic cones being bounced at once).
[*] Slightly updated the phone ringing sound for those who are averse to it.
[/list]
[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] When an enemy or Tino is stunned for more than 1 sec, the spinning dizzy sprite will show multiple times per extra second (up to 3).
[*] Added a bit of color to the entrance stairs to 61st St Station to help catch the eye more. There’s also a new loot box there to entice you in that direction.
[*] Added parallax on the overhead objects in the Branzino Cellar rooms.
[*] Updated the parallax on clouds to be based on camera position.
[*] The bricks from the miniboss encounter no appear above you.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where pausing and exiting the game while in the air falling right after a room transition, Tino would spawn in out of bounds and your save file would essentially be locked out. The solution is that you now cannot pause during this specific scenario. I had previously mentioned that this was fixed in the last patch, but I had accidentally left the code for the fix commented out.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing cargoyles from taking damage when crashing into solid objects at high speeds.
[*] Fixed a bug that was often preventing cars from blowing up when a cargoyle crashes into them.
[*] Fixed a bug where throwing an item at certain diagonal walls would get it stuck inside the wall.
[*] Fixed a bug where picking up a tutorial note didn’t trigger the achievement check. 
[*] The dialogue for a certain phone call only happens once now.
[*] Fixed a bug where when holding something, there was a scenario where you would stop holding it but remained in the holding state.
[*] Fixed a few areas where it was possible to get out of bounds using the spike cufflink.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.1002
notes.notes:
[b]New Season[/b]
Demo Season 1 has begun! The formula for calculating you high score is as follow: 

[b]((Enemies Killed * 200) + (Quartrs * 4) + (5000 per unlock) - (1000 * Deaths)) / Time[/b] 

If playing on easy difficulty the entire score is divided by 2. This season will last for at least 1 month! Rewards will be announced at a later date!

[b]New Achievements [/b]
A few new/updated visible achievements, and a whole lot of hidden achievements. Happy hunting!!! 
Added a few new hint trash items throughout the world.

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Tino can now only be stunned a maximum of 2 sec by a single attack.
[*] Tino now receives 50% less stun resistance after being stunned.
[*] Previosuly you were unable to parry attacks that knocked you back. This has been changed (although you still are unable to parry car-based attacks).
[*] The final boss’ 2nd phase received minor changes. The fire’s hitbox is now smaller and during the initial speed up of the drive, getting hit by the front does greatly reduced damage and knockback.
[/list]
